observed.front: Feb2018 Street View (sideB, h16; ref pass2/899-sideB_016, oblique, medium): white-grey lap siding, a beige walled court with an ochre cap left of the ESE unit door (second pair encloses the lower-station door; the first pair repeats it as production_inference), boarded lower windows with notices, wall vents. All windows are modeled as boarded panels (observed); front doors stay white as in 2018.

Fenced yards in Apr2019 are gone in 2025 (not modeled).
